# Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schemas (test fixtures)

Verbatim copies of the two JSON Schemas that Kiro's power documentation references. They are
used only by `test/power-manifest.test.ts`, so the tests never use the network. They are not
bundled and not shipped in `power-planchette/`.

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `plugin.schema.json` | https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec/blob/main/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json (served as https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json) |
| `mcp.schema.json` | https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec/blob/main/schemas/1.0.0/mcp.schema.json (served as https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/mcp.schema.json) |

Fetched on 28 Nov 2026.
